parsed.name: NI数据采集模拟输入通道
parsed.description: NI数据采集与传感器测量硬件上的模拟输入通道，用于接入并测量电压、电流、电阻、频率、声压以及桥式、应变、热电偶、RTD、热敏电阻、IEPE、LVDT/RVDT等传感器信号。实验室中常用于多类型传感器采集、信号调理、激励设置、滤波和标定。
parsed.description_en: An analog input channel on NI data acquisition and sensor measurement hardware, used to acquire voltage, current, resistance, frequency, sound pressure, and signals from bridge sensors, strain gauges, thermocouples, RTDs, thermistors, IEPE sensors, and LVDT/RVDT transducers. In laboratories it is commonly used for multi-sensor acquisition, signal conditioning, excitation setup, filtering, and calibration.
